  1|import { getOs } from "@cliffy/internal/runtime/get-os";
  2|import { snapshotTest } from "@cliffy/testing";
  3|import { CompletionsCommand } from "../../completions/mod.ts";
  4|import { HelpCommand } from "../../help/mod.ts";
  5|import { Command, EnumType, ValidationError } from "../../mod.ts";
  6|
  7|await snapshotTest({
  8|  name: "command integration",
  9|  meta: import.meta,
 10|  ignore: getOs() === "windows",
 11|  colors: true,
 12|  steps: {
 13|    "should complete boolean arg": {
 14|      args: ["completions", "complete", "boolean"],
 15|    },
 16|    "should complete boolean arg from foo command": {
 17|      args: ["completions", "complete", "boolean", "foo"],
 18|    },
 19|    "should complete boolean arg from foo bar command": {
 20|      args: ["completions", "complete", "boolean", "foo", "bar"],
 21|    },
 22|    "should complete available commands for help command": {
 23|      args: ["completions", "complete", "command", "help"],
 24|    },
 25|    "should complete enum": { args: ["completions", "complete", "color"] },
 26|    "should generate bash completions": { args: ["completions", "bash"] },
 27|    "should override name in bash completions": {
 28|      args: ["completions", "bash", "--name", "foo-command"],
 29|    },
 30|    "should generate fish completions": { args: ["completions", "fish"] },
 31|    "should override name in fish completions": {
 32|      args: ["completions", "fish", "--name", "foo-command"],
 33|    },
 34|    "should generate zsh completions": { args: ["completions", "zsh"] },
 35|    "should override name in zsh completions": {
 36|      args: ["completions", "zsh", "--name", "foo-command"],
 37|    },
 38|    "should output command help with help command": { args: ["help"] },
 39|    "should output sub-command help with help command": {
 40|      args: ["help", "foo"],
 41|    },
 42|    "should output short help with -h flag": { args: ["-h"] },
 43|    "should output long help with --help flag": { args: ["--help"] },
 44|    "should output short version with -V flag": { args: ["-V"] },
 45|    "should output long version with --version flag": { args: ["--version"] },
 46|    "should print the help of sub-command on validation error": {
 47|      args: ["bar"],
 48|      canFail: true,
 49|    },
 50|    "should print error message for unknown option with suggestion": {
 51|      args: ["--colorr"],
 52|      canFail: true,
 53|    },
 54|    "should print help and error message when validation error": {
 55|      args: ["validation-error"],
 56|      canFail: true,
 57|    },
 58|  },
 59|  async fn() {
 60|    await new Command()
 61|      .version("1.0.0")
 62|      .name("completions-test")
 63|      .description(`
 64|        Completions test.
 65|        
 66|          Completions test.
 67|        Completions test.
 68|      `)
 69|      .meta("meta1", "value1")
 70|      .meta("meta2", "value2")
 71|      .meta("meta3", "value3")
 72|      .globalType("color", new EnumType(["blue", "yellow", "red"]))
 73|      .globalOption("-g, --global <val:boolean>", "Foo option.")
 74|      .option(
 75|        "-m, --main <val:boolean>",
 76|        `
 77|        Bar option.
 78|          foo bar baz. foo bar baz.
 79|        
 80|        foo bar baz.
 81|        foo bar baz.`,
 82|      )
 83|      .option(
 84|        "--color=<val:color>",
 85|        "Color option with \"'quotes'\" and ([{brackets}]) \n and line breaks.",
 86|      )
 87|      .option("-C, --colors <val...:color>", "Color option.")
 88|      .arguments("<color:color> [path...:file]")
 89|      .default("help")
 90|      // foo
 91|      .command(
 92|        "foo",
 93|        new Command()
 94|          .description(
 95|            "Foo command with \"'quotes'\" and ([{brackets}]) \n and line breaks.",
 96|          )
 97|          .option("-f, --foo", "Foo option.")
 98|          // bar
 99|          .command("bar", "Bar command.")
100|          .option("-b, --bar", "Bar option.")
101|          .reset(),
102|      )
103|      .command("bar")
104|      .command("foo:bar")
105|      .option("-f, --file <path>", "...", { required: true })
106|      .command("validation-error")
107|      .action(() => {
108|        throw new ValidationError("Validation error message.", { exitCode: 1 });
109|      })
110|      .command("help", new HelpCommand().global())
111|      .command("completions", new CompletionsCommand())
112|      .parse();
113|  },
114|});
